result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the 90-day LOC instead of the 180-day figure. The change is one line in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` (line 906): the LOC argument was `loc180Days` and is now `loc90Days`. The percentage on that line already used `loc90Days`, so the block is consistent with its count and share.

`mvn -o -pl reports compile` and `mvn -o -pl reports test` both ran with no errors. I did not add a test for this block, and I did not regenerate a landscape report to look at the rendered output. Nothing is committed.
